pauses-thought-groups-v1.title: Hear where a pause falls
pauses-thought-groups-v1.text: At the old bridge the path turns toward the river.
pauses-thought-groups-v1.question: Which version keeps ‘the old bridge’ together?
pauses-thought-groups-v1.explanation: A pauses after ‘bridge’, leaving ‘the old bridge’ together. B puts the same added silence after ‘the’, splitting that group. Notice the position rather than copying the length.
pauses-thought-groups-v1.transfer_prompt: Choose one thought boundary in your own text to listen for. Keep short word groups connected when that supports the meaning.
pauses-thought-groups-v1.provenance_note: Synthesized speech for comparing pause positions, not a target voice or an assessment of your speech.

choices.label: A
choices.paused_text: At the old bridge / the path turns toward the river.

choices.label: B
choices.paused_text: At the / old bridge the path turns toward the river.
